subject: Preferred invoice delivery & interim collection plan
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@greenlinehealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Greenline AP <ap@greenlinehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 7 May 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Preferred invoice delivery & billing contact

Hi Rishi,

Quick question as we finalize procurement: what does Redwood prefer for invoice delivery and billing contact? Our AP team typically wants an emailed PDF to ap@greenlinehealth.com with a CC to procurement@greenlinehealth.com, but we can also accept vendor portal pushes if you support scheduled API pushes.

Two specifics we need on invoices:
- Include our PO number (PO GF-8897) on each invoice
- Break out VAT/GST amounts by line and show your legal entity and VAT ID for reconciliation

Can you confirm what you can do today and whether you recommend portal enrollment? Procurement would like to know if we need to schedule an onboarding window — that could take a few weeks.

Thanks,
Samantha Lee
Accounts Payable Manager
Greenline Health
Samantha.Lee@greenlinehealth.com
+1 (617) 555-0123

Attachment: Greenline_AP_Format.pdf (stub - AP remit layout requested)
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@greenlinehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 7 May 2027 11:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Preferred invoice delivery & billing contact

Hi Samantha — thanks for the details. Short answers up front:
- We support both: portal pushes (API/webhook) and scheduled manual PDF emails.
- Portal enrollment gives the cleanest automation (invoice status, retries, signed payloads) but I appreciate procurement onboarding can be slower.

A few clarifying items so I can propose an operational plan:
1) Which legal entity should appear on the invoice (company name + VAT ID)? If you copy the PO into the reply I will map it to the correct entity.
2) Do you require the invoice PDF to match your exact AP layout (the attached Greenline_AP_Format.pdf helps) or is a standard Redwood PDF with line-level VAT sufficient?
3) Do you want invoice copies sent to any other internal mailbox (ops/accounts@greenlinehealth.com)?

If procurement needs time to onboard to the portal, we can do a temporary nightly email push to ap@greenlinehealth.com (with CC to procurement) while we set up portal access. Operational proposal:
- Today -> Manual scheduled PDF emails starting next billing cycle (we can configure template to include PO GF-8897 and VAT breakdown).
- Parallel -> Kick off portal onboarding (I can introduce our onboarding lead) with a target completion date — what does procurement estimate?

If that plan works I will loop in Kimberly (billing) and Connor (AP integration) to coordinate the template and the scheduled job.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0188
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@greenlinehealth.com>

Date: Sat, 8 May 2027 08:22:00 -0400

On Fri, May 7, 2027 at 11:03 AM Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com> wrote:
> If procurement needs time to onboard to the portal, we can do a temporary nightly email push to ap@greenlinehealth.com (with CC to procurement) while we set up portal access.

Thanks — that would work. Procurement expects vendor onboarding to finish around 2027-06-15 (we need vendor forms + W-9/VAT substantiation). For the interim we request:
- Emailed PDF invoices today/next billing cycle to ap@greenlinehealth.com (please CC procurement@greenlinehealth.com).
- Each PDF should display PO GF-8897 on the first page and a VAT breakdown per line.
- Please include vendor legal name and VAT number on the header so our ERP can auto-apply tax codes.

I'll attach our AP format as reference (Greenline_AP_Format.pdf). Once portal onboarding is ready we can switch over; we'll confirm the exact go-live date with procurement.

Appreciate the quick turn.

Samantha Lee
Accounts Payable Manager
Greenline Health
Attachment: Greenline_AP_Format.pdf (sample remit layout)
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@greenlinehealth.com>, Greenline AP <ap@greenlinehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: FW: Preferred invoice delivery & billing contact — interim delivery plan and next steps

Kimberly / Connor — looping you in to execute an interim collection flow for Greenline. Summary and proposed actions:

Context: Greenline (PO GF-8897) cannot complete vendor portal onboarding until ~2027-06-15. They need interim emailed invoices with VAT breakdown and PO on the header so their ERP will reconcile.

Proposed interim runbook (nightly until portal go-live):
- Connor: create a scheduled job (SFTP -> mailer or direct SMTP) to send finalized invoice PDFs to ap@greenlinehealth.com nightly. CC procurement@greenlinehealth.com. Target first run: next billing cycle (invoice dated 2027-05-31).
- Kimberly: approve the invoice template changes so the PDF mirrors Greenline's required fields (PO in header, VAT per line, vendor legal name & VAT ID). See attached sample: redwood_sample_invoice_for_greenline.pdf and mapping spreadsheet invoice_mapping_greenline.xlsx.
- Rishi: I'll update the HubSpot deal (HS-33921) and track the portal onboarding milestone; I'll also send the onboarding contact for procurement to Samantha.

Questions/notes:
- Can we include the PO in both the PDF visual and the invoice metadata (the metadata helps the nightly webhook if we later map to their portal)?
- If we need a one-off credit or amendment to match their AP fields, flag now — procurement may require a signed addendum; DocuSign link is in related_links.

Samantha, copying you so procurement has visibility. If this looks good I'll mark the task as "interim-email-push" and assign owners.

Thanks,
Rishi
Senior Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
